# Start here — your image, the whole story

Welcome to **Civitai Metadata Studio**. Open an AI image, understand its hidden recipe, fix the record, and save a new copy—without re-encoding the pixels.

You do not need ComfyUI, an account, or any special terminology to get started.

## A first session worth trying

1. Open one PNG, JPEG, or WebP you are comfortable inspecting locally.
2. Read **Generation**, **Resources**, **Other metadata**, and **Review**.
3. Make a small edit. Keep **Verify pixel integrity** enabled.
4. Save a new copy and reopen it to inspect the result.

Want to discard an image? Use **Remove**, **Clear**, or **Clear all**. Saving does not empty the queue, and clearing does not delete your original files.

## Four things to know up front

- **Images stay local.** Exact Civitai lookups send identifiers/hashes; explicit search/import sends your chosen query/public image ID. Turn off automatic verification and avoid network actions for local-only work.
- **Dimensions begin with real pixels.** Editing width/height changes metadata, not the image's resolution.
- **A verified resource is an identity match.** It does not prove historical use, authorship, permission, or a completely reproducible recipe.
- **Sharing needs a privacy check.** Original ComfyUI carriers remain unchanged and can contain private notes/paths. Audit reports can include prompts.

## Make yourself at home

Use **Q&A** for help, **Ideas** for exploration, **Show and tell** for public-safe examples, and **Announcements** for project news. Minimal synthetic examples are especially welcome. Please follow the [community code of conduct](https://github.com/chriscollins500/civitai-metadata-studio/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

The [roadmap](https://github.com/chriscollins500/civitai-metadata-studio/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) is directional, not a set of promised dates. Clear evidence, preserved originals, accessibility, and privacy remain the priorities.
